chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Safwan, from Ishaq ibn 'Ammar, from Abi Ibrahim عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about the slanderer, and he said: “He is to be beaten with a beating between the two beatings; his whole body is to be struck.”

key_terms.الْمُفْتَرِي: the one who fabricates a false accusation or slander
key_terms.جَسَدُهُ كُلُّهُ: his entire body, meaning the punishment is distributed over the body
key_terms.ضَرْبًا بَيْنَ الضَّرْبَيْنِ: a moderate beating between two extremes
key_terms.يُضْرَبُ: he is to be struck as a legal punishment

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling in Tahdhib al-Ahkam on punishing a slanderer?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the punishment of the one who commits false accusation or slander. It indicates that the punishment is a disciplinary beating of a moderate kind, and that it is administered across the body.
